scope: Data-bearing manuscript figures, tables, and adjacent numerical claims

entries.selection: VM-P1 sparse_policy_trial rows and performance-eligible L1 strict-matrix rows; three observations per path
entries.transformation: P1 uses mean active_seconds; L1 uses mean measured_stage_seconds; relative changes are computed against staging within each workload and metric
entries.caption_claim: Separate P1 complete-active and L1 source-read/conversion comparisons; no pooled path effect
supported_manuscript_claims: L1 direct stage was 0.7% longer and effectively neutral
limitations: P1 staging lacks a source-read counter with the same definition
P1 and L1 use different timing metrics and must not be pooled

entries.selection: All parseable historical guest-adaptation durations classified as TCG or KVM
entries.transformation: Descriptive min, max, arithmetic mean, and median by execution environment
entries.caption_claim: Observed guest-adaptation duration distributions by execution environment
supported_manuscript_claims: 42 parsed TCG runs and 48 parsed KVM runs
limitations: The historical TCG and KVM workloads are heterogeneous
The ratio is descriptive, not a causal same-workload speedup
The public file contains a group summary rather than journal-linked per-run observations

entries.selection: VM-E through VM-H low-downtime TCG and KVM groups; three repetitions per environment and workload
entries.transformation: Mean downtime_s by workload and environment; reduction is one minus KVM mean divided by TCG mean
entries.caption_claim: Same-workload effect of the conversion worker execution environment
supported_manuscript_claims: KVM shortened controlled cutover means by 70.3% to 79.6%
limitations: The TCG/KVM comparison concerns the worker execution environment and is reported separately from the protocol results
The comparison does not establish performance for other hardware or workloads

entries.selection: Primary low-downtime traces without post-shutdown recovery, with a second row adding three known shared-network contention traces
entries.transformation: Count, arithmetic mean, median, range, and sample standard deviation of offline_cutover_seconds
entries.caption_claim: Ordinary-path cutover distribution and network-contention sensitivity
supported_manuscript_claims: Normal path n=42, mean 174.7 s, median 92 s
Sensitivity n=45, mean 263.5 s, median 97 s
limitations: Post-shutdown recovery cases are summarized separately from ordinary-path cutover times
The three contention traces remain public and are not deleted

entries.selection: VM-P1 and VM-P2 sparse-policy triplicates plus the named B600 historical boundary pair
entries.transformation: Mean active_seconds, measured_stage_seconds, and source_read_gib for each sparse policy; direct and staged B600 active durations are reported without pooling
entries.caption_claim: Sparse-copy behavior and the full-read boundary of direct output
supported_manuscript_claims: B600 direct full read took 114.0 min versus 27.6 min staged
limitations: B600 is a boundary counterexample, not a representative workload
Sparse-policy rows do not establish a universal direct-write speedup

entries.selection: L2 current-workset repetitions after the source-content change
entries.transformation: Median and range of measured_stage_seconds and wall_seconds within staged and direct paths
supported_manuscript_claims: Direct complete-task wall time was 64.6% shorter because staged import was slow
limitations: The wall-time difference is not attributed to direct-write speed
Rows span supplemental revisions and have asymmetric second-stage throughput

entries.transformation: Status counts, successful target-disk sum, sampled-block sum, and group-checkpoint row count
supported_manuscript_claims: 102 successful target disks and 768 sampled source-target locations
limitations: Sampled blocks are not whole-disk hashes
Running and console evidence do not establish application-level availability

entries.selection: All 12 final FC rows, kept separate from the 66-row matrix
entries.transformation: Terminal-status counts and hashes of retained source records
entries.caption_claim: Final repetition of the core fault boundaries
supported_manuscript_claims: 10 rows succeeded and 2 declared rollback rows failed as expected
limitations: Correctness-only cohort; excluded from performance aggregates
Expected failures count only when fault_point is direct_conversion.after
